item.title: Budget 2026-27 sets aside Rs 20,000 crore to accelerate carbon capture in heavy industry
item.description: The Union Budget 2026-27 allocates Rs 20,000 crore to boost carbon capture technologies in heavy industries, aligning with India's Net Zero 2070 strategy. This investment targets sectors like steel and cement.

item.title: IT a core driver of India’s growth in Budget 2026-27
item.description: The 2026-27 Budget highlights IT as a key growth driver, raising safe harbour thresholds and promoting AI and semiconductor initiatives. A tax holiday for foreign firms using Indian data centers aims to boost global investment.

item.title: Heatwaves and lightning should be added to national disaster list, Finance Commission says
item.description: The 16th Finance Commission recommends adding heatwaves and lightning to India's national disaster list, citing rising deaths and extreme weather. This move would enable states to access disaster funds more directly, with Rs 1.4 lakh crore allocated for disaster management in 2026-27.
